bindings.label: 第 2 段
bindings.display_text: 阿卡的反扑，停在抢七最后关头。
bindings.text: 阿卡的反扑，停在抢七最后关头。

bindings.label: 第 4 段
bindings.display_text: 北京时间十月十二日晚上，上海大师赛第三轮。
bindings.text: 北京时间十月十二日晚上，上海大师赛第三轮。

bindings.label: 第 6 段
bindings.display_text: 贝尔格斯用网前放短拿分，迫使阿卡向前追球。东京夺冠之后，他在上海遭遇新的考验。
bindings.text: 贝尔格斯用网前放短拿分，迫使阿卡向前追球。东京夺冠之后，他在上海遭遇新的考验。

bindings.label: 第 8 段
bindings.display_text: 首盘三比二落后，阿卡立即回破，追成三比三。五比五之后，再次丢掉发球局，五比七输掉首盘。
bindings.text: 首盘三比二落后，阿卡立即回破，追成三比三。五比五之后，再次丢掉发球局，五比七输掉首盘。

bindings.label: 第 11 段
bindings.display_text: 第二盘，贝尔格斯打出穿越，突破阿卡的网前防线。双方保发，悬念拖到盘末。
bindings.text: 第二盘，贝尔格斯打出穿越，突破阿卡的网前防线。双方保发，悬念拖到盘末。

bindings.label: 第 13 段
bindings.display_text: 四比四，阿卡保住发球局，五比四领先。握拳、怒吼，他还不肯让这场球结束。
bindings.text: 四比四，阿卡保住发球局，五比四领先。握拳、怒吼，他还不肯让这场球结束。

bindings.label: 第 15 段
bindings.display_text: 对手同样保发，追到五比五。盘末的拉锯，谁先松手，谁就陷入危险。
bindings.text: 对手同样保发，追到五比五。盘末的拉锯，谁先松手，谁就陷入危险。

bindings.label: 第 20 段
bindings.display_text: 五比六，十五比四十。阿卡又到悬崖边上。他守住这次机会，回破，把比赛拉回六比六。
bindings.text: 五比六，十五比四十。阿卡又到悬崖边上。他守住这次机会，回破，把比赛拉回六比六。

bindings.label: 第 22 段
bindings.display_text: 一发得分率，阿卡百分之六十六，对手百分之七十九。制胜分少了八个。下一站，他能把反扑变成胜利吗？

method: Fresh frozen full-utterance native edge Yunjian +6%/+0Hz baseline, MP3+paired native ZIP WordBoundary. Finite same-utterance nonoriginal correct/wrong homophone MFCC+F0 contrasts with LOO calibration. Low/uncertain/unreliable/no-reference remain limitations. No historical sentence pass, ASR tone proof, or human listening claimed.
limitations: MFCC/F0 homophone tests are finite relative comparisons, not exhaustive pronunciation certification.
Low confidence, far-from-both, unreliable, uncertain, no refs and reference-limited cases are retained pending.
WordBoundary tokens are tokenizer segmentation, not phoneme ground truth.

diagnostic_uncertainty_review_records.reason: The intended controls 肆/饲 contain only one voiced F0 sample in their own unpadded WordBoundary target estimate while ORIG remains inside a merged score token. Padded combined result is dominated by nonmatching pitch samples/estimated token splits; both reference sides also shift adjacent audio. This cannot establish a stable si1 misread.

diagnostic_uncertainty_review_records.sentence: 对手同样保发，追到五比五。盘末的拉锯，谁先松手，谁就陷入危险。
diagnostic_uncertainty_review_records.reason: The supposed wrong contrast is bi3 versus pi3, whose lexical tones are equal. Combined misread is driven by F0 (-0.668) while spectral score weakly favors intended (+0.062); substitutions change score-word segmentation and third-tone grouping. Positive 笔 has pitch pattern close to ORIG but was dropped by the mutual classifier, while 彼/鄙 induce different pitch/neighbor trajectories. This cannot independently establish b→p mispronunciation.
